title: Maverick: Private and Verifiable LLM Inference Made Practical via Matrix-Vector Multiplication Delegation
abstract: arXiv:2609.10264v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Open-source large language models (LLMs) are increasingly competitive with closed-source models while offering transparency and the ability to run inference without exposing user inputs to a service provider. However, running large-scale models locally requires substantial computational resources. In practice, users may still resort to a third-party provider, giving rise to privacy and correctness concerns. Existing solutions that address these problems often impose substantial server overhead or introduce additional trust assumptions.   In this paper, we present Maverick, a novel approach to private and verifiable LLM inference based on a protocol for delegating matrix-vector multiplication, a dominant operation in LLMs. At its core, Maverick provides, to our knowledge, the first information-theoretically sound verification protocol for matrix-vector multiplication delegation with transparent preprocessing, efficient (batch) v

translated_title: Maverick：通过矩阵-向量乘法委托实现实用的隐私保护与可验证的LLM推理
translated_abstract: 开源大语言模型在与闭源模型的竞争中日益具有竞争力，同时提供了透明性以及在不向服务提供商暴露用户输入的情况下运行推理的能力。然而，在本地运行大规模模型需要大量的计算资源。在实践中，用户可能仍然需要求助于第三方提供商，这引发了隐私和正确性方面的担忧。解决这些问题的现有方案通常会带来大量的服务器开销或引入额外的信任假设。在本文中，我们提出了Maverick，这是一种基于矩阵-向量乘法委托协议（LLM中的主导运算）的隐私保护且可验证的LLM推理新方法。据我们所知，Maverick的核心贡献在于提供了首个具有透明预处理、高效（批量）验证的信息论安全的矩阵-向量乘法委托验证协议。
tldr: Maverick提出了一种基于矩阵-向量乘法委托协议的实用隐私保护且可验证的LLM推理方案，实现了首个信息论安全的验证协议，同时避免了现有方案所需的高昂服务器开销或额外的信任假设。
en_tdlr: Maverick presents a practical approach to private and verifiable LLM inference via matrix-vector multiplication delegation, providing the first information-theoretically sound verification protocol with transparent preprocessing while avoiding substantial server overhead or additional trust assumptions.
